_note: v2.4 plan 05 mirror key hygiene, MEASUREMENT (run on the same page right after `so-journey run J3` x2, with an `st-session reload` BEFORE the first J3 so the tally starts at zero; no reload in between: the tally is page memory). Reads LoreEvidence.mirrorRates(): per `so_` relationship entry of the chat's mirror book, the loud generations whose scan view held it enabled (eligible) and how many fired it. PREDECLARED RULE (decided 2026-09-23, never retuned): strip roster/persona names from mirror keys ONLY IF the median rate >= 0.8 over entries with eligible >= 3; otherwise record the rate and change nothing. This fixture applies the rule and returns the verdict; it asserts only that there was something to measure.

requires.prior: st-session reload, then so-journey run J3 twice on the same page (the mirror-rate tally is page memory)
requires.why: a measurement over J3's real loud generations; run standalone in a batch it has nothing to measure

steps.eval: const ev = globalThis.storyOrchestratorLoreEvidence; if (!ev) throw new Error('no evidence ring on this build'); const rows = ev.mirrorRates().filter((row) => row.eligible >= 3); if (!rows.length) throw new Error(`nothing to measure: no mirror entry was eligible in 3+ loud generations (${JSON.stringify(ev.mirrorRates())})`); const rates = rows.map((row) => row.rate).sort((a, b) => a - b); const mid = Math.floor(rates.length / 2); const median = rates.length % 2 ? rates[mid] : (rates[mid - 1] + rates[mid]) / 2; return { entries: rows.length, median, verdict: median >= 0.8 ? 'STRIP (median >= 0.8): build the key strip' : 'RECORD ONLY (median < 0.8): change nothing', rows };
